datasets.title: MOLA MEGDR median topography
datasets.format: PDS3 detached label and big-endian int16 IMG
datasets.processing: Bilinear sampling at exact target cell centers; spherical gradient slope; edge-padded 3x3 elevation population standard deviation.
limitations: Coarse altimetry smooths boulders and local slopes.
MEGDR includes interpolated bins; equatorial profile gaps can reach 12 km.

datasets.title: THEMIS Day IR controlled mosaic
datasets.processing: Nearest rendered grayscale pixel at target centers divided by 255; transparent pixels become nodata.
limitations: Relative display brightness, not temperature or thermal inertia; illumination and surface texture affect values.

datasets.title: Odyssey NS epithermal neutron flux
datasets.resolution: 0.5 degree bins; instrument footprint much larger; latitude-band subset -5.5..-3.5 and 17.5..19.5 degrees
datasets.processing: Nearest 0.5-degree bin; index=clip(1-flux/maximum flux in downloaded latitude bands,0,1).
limitations: Neutron suppression is a hydrogen-sensitive comparison proxy, not water fraction or confirmation of ice; composition also affects neutrons.
Mapped water-ice evidence indicates presence or likelihood, not extractability or accessibility.

datasets.title: Mars 2020 MEDA daily summaries (sampled sols)
datasets.spatial_coverage: Perseverance rover location (moves along its traverse in Jezero crater)
datasets.resolution: One row per sampled sol (daily min/max/mean of ~1 Hz samples)
datasets.format: PDS4 CSV (calibrated ATS; derived PS, RHS) reduced to JSON
datasets.processing: Complete per-sol CSVs streamed; air temperature = mean of ATS_LOCAL_TEMP1-3 per sample (K-273.15); pressure from derived PS; local RH from derived RHS; finite air 120-320 K, pressure 100-1500 Pa, RH 0-100 percent (zero retained); known placeholders rejected; legacy cache caveats in environment JSON; daily min/max/mean; LTST of min/max air temperature recorded.
limitations: ATS sensors sit about 1 m above ground near the rover; readings can include rover thermal contamination and are not free-stream atmospheric temperature.
RHS relative humidity is local to the sensor temperature, not near-surface ambient RH.
Wind (WS) omitted: very large files at the archive download rate and documented sensor damage periods.
Historical point data at a moving rover; not current conditions and not representative of the whole region.

datasets.title: MSL REMS daily summaries (sampled sols)
datasets.spatial_coverage: Curiosity rover location (traversing from Bradbury Landing up Mount Sharp)
datasets.resolution: One row per sampled sol (daily min/max/mean)
datasets.format: PDS4 calibrated MODRDR (RMD) tables reduced to JSON
datasets.processing: Complete per-sol RMD tables streamed; AMBIENT_TEMP and BRIGHTNESS_TEMP K-273.15; PRESSURE Pa; LOCAL_RELATIVE_HUMIDITY %; -999 treated as missing; finite air 120-320 K, ground 150-330 K, pressure 100-1500 Pa, RH 0-100 percent; legacy cache caveats in environment JSON; daily min/max/mean.
limitations: REMS air temperature is measured on the mast booms about 1.6 m above ground and can include rover thermal effects.
REMS wind sensor was damaged at landing; wind is omitted.

Ground temperature is GTS infrared brightness temperature of a small patch beside the rover; only the daily maximum is published because unfiltered nighttime minima reach the sensor floor (about -170 C), which is not physical.
Historical point data at a moving rover; not current conditions and not representative of the whole region.

datasets.title: Mars landing sites and science targets
datasets.processing: Landing sites transcribed from the PDS Geosciences ODE landing-site table or peer-reviewed papers (per-feature source_ref) and converted to east-positive -180..180; science targets digitized approximately from cited NASA images and maps.
limitations: Science-target positions are approximate.
Coordinates are not suitable for navigation.

datasets.title: Mars Trek MOLA color shaded relief
datasets.processing: Stitch 8 x 4 zoom-2 JPEG tiles without resampling; north at top, east-positive longitude -180 at left to +180 at right.
limitations: Color encodes elevation and shaded relief; not true-color surface imagery.

datasets.title: Mars Trek MOLA ClrShade WMTS basemap
datasets.resolution: 463 m source product; WMTS zoom levels 0-7
datasets.processing: Mars Trek color shaded relief tiles served directly to the map; no AreoPath stitching or resampling.
limitations: Color encodes elevation and shaded relief; not true-color surface imagery.

datasets.title: NASA Mars mission history (curated)
datasets.processing: Hand-curated from NASA mission pages; each key result links to its source.
limitations: Short summaries; not a complete mission record.
End dates are last contact or declared end as published.

datasets.title: Tianwen-1 / Zhurong published landing-site and mission record
limitations: Non-NASA mission; included for context only.

datasets.title: Published Mars water-ice context (generalized)
datasets.processing: Latitude bands and points transcribed from cited publications; boundaries generalized.
limitations: Mapped water-ice evidence indicates presence or likelihood, not extractability or accessibility.
Bands are generalized from publications and are not ice maps.

datasets.title: Stack et al. (2020), Photogeologic Map of the Perseverance Rover Field Site, SSR 216:127
datasets.spatial_coverage: Connected Seitah-associated dune complex, Jezero crater
datasets.resolution: Generalized vector exterior; estimated uncertainty 250-500 m
datasets.processing: GIS supplement https://static-content.springer.com/esm/art%3A10.1007%2Fs11214-020-00739-x/MediaObjects/11214_2020_739_MOESM3_ESM.zip ; SHA-256 970e4c78ae6dc689c99e46eddb4be184704a56952008d0558f643e816e29b118. Select Crater floor fractured 1 / Aeolian bedforms, large; repair, dissolve, select connected component at [77.441,18.439], fill 100 holes, simplify exterior at 150 native meters, analytically invert Mars spherical equirectangular projection (R=3396190 m). See docs/hazard_outlines/seitah/NOTES.md.
limitations: Estimated regional uncertainty 250-500 m, not measured ground-truth accuracy.
Includes internal bedrock gaps and adjoining dune tongues; not continuous sand or an exact named-region boundary.
Not for navigation. Absence of a mapped hazard does not mean the terrain is safe.
datasets.license: Open access article, CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); geometry derived from its published GIS supplement (units selected, dissolved, simplified, reprojected by the team) with attribution to Stack et al. (2020).

datasets.title: NASA MMGIS MSL CTX ortho mosaic: Bagnold Dunes derived envelope
datasets.mission: Mars Science Laboratory / Curiosity; Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter
datasets.spatial_coverage: Bagnold dune belt, Gale crater; clipped to preset bbox [137.2,-4.9,137.6,-4.5]
datasets.resolution: Approx. 20 m/pixel sampled imagery; boundary uncertainty 200-500 m, locally about 1 km
datasets.processing: NASA public configuration and CTX TMS tiles https://mars.nasa.gov/mmgis-maps/MSL/Layers/MSL_CTX_ortho_mosaic_6m/{z}/{x}/{y}.png ; 30 zoom-12 tiles (x=3608..3613, TMS y=1992..1996), 1536x1280 mosaic. Manually trace 56 pixel vertices; three grid controls define affine transform to longitude/latitude; clip, round to seven decimals and orient CCW (52 distinct vertices). Affine approximation residual 2.04 m. See docs/hazard_outlines/bagnold/NOTES.md and raw/digitization.json there.
limitations: Estimated boundary uncertainty 200-500 m, locally about 1 km; not a statistical accuracy measurement.
Includes bedrock gaps and sand aprons; smaller patches may be omitted; western clipping edge is not a natural field boundary.
Not for navigation. Absence of a mapped hazard does not mean the terrain is safe.
